utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help once the drop-off spot and timing are confirmed. Kira and Dane are both waiting on those details, too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia. I can sort the donations and hand out tools once we know the drop-off spot and timing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a wrench and a measuring tape to the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That helps, Gus — can you confirm Tess has the time and fix list set first? Then we’ll know whether Eli and Quinn can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check with Tess about the time and fix list, then I’ll let you know about Eli and Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll gather folks, make a quick list of the repair jobs, and set a time for the repair drive. Eli can help spread the word and bring any tools he’s got.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word too, and I’ll keep checking on the drop-off spot so we’ve got a clear place for everything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a huge help, Jules — thank you. I’ll pin down the time and get that job list ready so we can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll spread the word and bring any donated items by 10 on Saturday at the school lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Hana — I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive plan, and Rosa’s sending me the latest details too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — that matches what I have. I’ll see you Saturday at 10 at the school lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring my gloves and a small toolkit. Is there anything else you need me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That should help a lot—thanks. If you see Vik, he’s keeping the repair drive plan clear, and Opal has the side-gate drop-off spot with the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I’ll look for Vik and check the side-gate drop-off with Opal.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can swing by and help with the repair drive. Just point me to whatever still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That would really help, Mara. I can manage the sign-in, and I’ll let you know if the bigger items need moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, just let me know what still needs sorting or moving and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can sort the donations and hand out tools at the repair drive. Faye’s checking the school schedule and will get back to me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Faye — I’ll spread the word and let folks know Hana’s still lining up the drop-off spot and a few helpers. Just send me the final details when you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll keep an eye on the school schedule and pass along the final time once it’s set. Saturday at the school lot still works for now, and I can adjust if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help at the sign-in table and sort the donations again. If the big items need moving, I can give a ride too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday at the school lot still works for me. If the time shifts, I can adjust around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday at the school lot works for me too. I’ll keep helping at sign-in and with the donations, and I can handle the ride for the big items if needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rosa’s got it organized and moving, which is a relief. Vik can keep folks posted, and Mara can handle the sign-in table if we need her.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great. We still need help sorting the donations and a ride for the big items, and Mara can cover both if needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, then we’ve got the plan lined up. Let’s have Mara sort the donations and cover the big-item ride if needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been asking around for volunteers for the repair drive. Oren’s sorting donations and checking the tool table too, so it’s coming together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good to hear. I’ll do a quick check of the broken stuff and make a list, and I’ll bring a hammer, screwdriver, and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great, Leo. I’ll keep asking around and pass along any extra hands or supplies I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll keep it low-key for Uli and let Leo make the list. If Noah can sort the donations, we’ll be in good shape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the drop-off by the side gate, and the community shed is still set for supplies. If you want, I can also keep track of who’s coming and going while Ira’s out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Opal—please keep an eye on arrivals and departures. With the side gate drop-off and the shed set, we’re in great shape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got my toolbox and a few screwdrivers ready for the repair drive. If you see any tape or pliers, send them my way—I keep forgetting where I put them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ve got the rest covered for the repair drive, and I’ll bring you any tape or pliers I spot. See you there with the others.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — I’ll be at the tool table sorting things out. If you spot Nell, let her know I’m ready to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can swing by and help sort donations for the repair drive. Just let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Noah — I’ll keep folks posted on the plan and spread the word about what’s still needed. Rosa’s sending me the latest details, so I’ll let you know as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — just ping me when you hear from Rosa, and I’ll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help sort the donations for the repair drive, and if Sam still needs a ride for the big items, I can ask around.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara. I’ve got the side gate drop-off spot covered, and Rosa’s handling the community shed unless we need to shift things.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll keep sorting the donations, and I’ll ask around about a ride for Sam’s big items.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still lining up a few helpers and a drop-off spot, and I’ll keep checking in on the location. As soon as Opal knows it, I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll handle the rest for the repair drive. I’ll meet folks there and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep checking for the location and let everyone know as soon as Opal has it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands, so I’ll keep an eye out for folks dropping things off. Good to hear Vik’s keeping it clear, and Bo’s got the east block covered with the flyers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks—if you can send me the drop-off spot and timing, I can help out too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check the drop-off spot and timing while I’m out, then send it over. Appreciate the help, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got heavy-duty tape, screwdrivers, batteries, and a couple tarps on my list for the repair drive. I did bring extra tape and a few gloves, so Bo’s handling the rest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Tess is the one gathering folks, listing the jobs, and setting the time for the repair drive, right? If there’s a clear time and short fix list, Eli can help too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, that sounds right—Tess is organizing the people, jobs, and time. If we lock in a clear time and a short fix list, Eli can jump in too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll round up the neighbors, make a list of the repair jobs, and set a time for the drive. Eli can help spread the word and bring whatever tools he’s got.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my toolbox and a few extra tools too. Just tell me what’s needed, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Gus — I’ll get the job list together and let you know what tools we still need. I’ll also set the time and pass the word around to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I can adjust around the school schedule if the repair drive time shifts. Once Leo sends the final time, I’ll help keep everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye — that really helps. We still need someone to sort the donations and a ride for the big items, and Mara can cover both if needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can help coordinate around the school schedule, and if Mara needs anything from me for the donations or big items, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me — Rosa keeps it organized, Vik spreads the word, and Mara can handle the sign-in table if needed. I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — I just need the drop-off spot and timing confirmed before I can help with the repair items. Once that’s set, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rosa’s still organizing that, and she’ll send Vik the latest plan. I’ll wait for the drop-off spot and timing, then we can keep it simple and on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I brought my toolbox and a few screwdrivers—now I’m just looking for tape and pliers for the repair drive. I can help sort the tool table too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’ve got tape and pliers here—you can put them on the tool table.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, great—thanks, Uli. I’ll put them on the tool table and keep sorting the donations.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the donations and hand out tools at the repair drive. I’m waiting on Faye to check the school schedule and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be a huge help, Rey. I’ll keep asking around for more volunteers while we wait on Faye.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell. I’ll be ready once Faye gets back to me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring a hammer, a screwdriver, and duct tape. I’ll also check the broken stuff and make a quick list before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Leo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll let Hana know you’re on it and share the list when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll check the broken stuff and send the list over once it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring gloves and my small toolkit. Is there anything else you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s so helpful, Mina. If you can also keep an eye out for anything that needs a quick sort, I’ll have Leo make a list and Noah can help with the donations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can do that. Have Leo send me the list, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything quick to sort.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll bring over a short list of the fixes I know about.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Dane. We still need help sorting the donations and a ride for the big items for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help sort the donations, and I’ll ask around about a ride for the big items.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Tess is setting the time and listing the jobs, right? And Quinn’s the one spreading the word?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Right — Tess has the timing and job list, and Quinn’s handling the word. I’ve got the side gate drop-off spot, and I’m keeping track of everything that comes in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — and Eli can help once there’s a clear time and a short list of fixes, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring my gloves and a small toolkit. Is there anything else you want me to grab for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Just your toolkit and gloves is perfect, thanks. I’m still checking the drop-off spot and will spread the word as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring those and wait for the drop-off spot update.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help sort the donations and cover the sign-in table again. Just let me know what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara. I’ll do a quick check of the broken stuff and make a list, then I’ll bring a hammer, a screwdriver, and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Leo — once you’ve got the list, I can jump in where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been asking around for volunteers for the repair drive. If you hear of anyone who can help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help once the drop-off spot and timing are confirmed. Just send me those details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Pia — I’ll pass along the drop-off spot and timing as soon as I hear them. I appreciate you being willing to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can come by for a bit and help where I can. Just point me to the parts that need fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Uli — keep it low-key and start with the parts that are easiest to fix. I’ll handle the rest and meet up with everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good — I’ll start with the easy fixes and keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ve got it — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive, and I’ll bring any donated items by 10 at the school lot on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Hana — thanks. I’ll bring a few extra tools to the school lot on Saturday too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. See you Saturday at 10 at the school lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—Saturday at the school lot still works for me, and I can adjust if the time shifts. Hana can spread the word, and I’ll help coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks — I’ll keep my list updated and let Bo handle the rest. I’m still short on heavy-duty tape, screwdrivers, batteries, and a couple tarps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — I’ll keep those items in mind and help coordinate around the school schedule. Just let me know once the final time is set, and I’ll adjust if needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll gather folks, make a list of the repair jobs, and set a time for the drive. Eli can help spread the word and bring any tools he has.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Tess. I’ll check in with Noah, Leo, and Uli so we can keep the repair drive moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Rosa — I appreciate that. Once you’ve checked in, let’s compare notes and I’ll lock in the time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m out running errands, so I’ll keep an eye out for anyone dropping things off for the repair drive. Glad Bo’s taking the east block with the flyer stack and Vik’s keeping the plan clear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’m sorting the donations and the tool table now. If you spot any tape or pliers, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out for tape or pliers while I’m out and bring them by if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hana’s still sorting the repair drive details and lining up a drop-off spot, but she’s gathering a few helpers too. I’ll let you know as soon as it’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I can sort the donations and hand out tools when it’s set up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be amazing, Rey — I’ll pass it along as soon as Hana locks in the details.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
